# Unit 7: Storage Management, Protection and Security

## Disk Scheduling Algorithms
Disk scheduling manages hard disk seek times and head movements across cylinder tracks:
- SSTF (Shortest Seek Time First): Selects request closest to current head position.
- SCAN (Elevator Algorithm): Moves disk arm back and forth across tracks.
- C-SCAN (Circular SCAN): Moves arm in one direction, servicing requests, then immediately returns to track 0.

## Protection & Access Matrix
Protection restricts resource access by user processes. An Access Matrix represents domains as rows and objects as columns, defining access rights (Read, Write, Execute).
System threats include buffer overflow vulnerabilities, malware (viruses, worms, trojans, rootkits), and denial of service attacks.
